canada.summary: The Department of National Defence also says four of the 25 soldiers who remain hospitalized have been relocated to centres in British Columbia and Ontario.

canada.title: More research needed on Port of Churchill expansion's impact on wildlife, report says
canada.summary: Research into how a project like the proposed expansion of the Port of Churchill would affect some local wildlife is "surprisingly scant," a marine conservation non-profit group says.

canada.title: Vancouver Island surfers oppose potential breakwater at popular beach
canada.summary: Surfers who frequent Jordan River say a proposed breakwater would destroy the remote beach, while the company proposing it says it would cut down on tug boat trips.

canada.title: Fewer Montrealers are placing bets, but online gambling has tripled: new study
canada.summary: Fewer Montrealers are gambling than they were seven to eight years ago. But online gambling is moving in the opposite direction — nearly tripling since 2018. And public health researchers say that shift comes with risks.

canada.title: Forget EverWind’s AI data centre. What Nova Scotia needs is strong and stable cell phone and internet service
canada.summary: Besides, the Examiner would have more subscribers if Nova Scotia had better high-speed internet service.

canada.title: N.W.T.'s muskox population to be assessed by species at risk committee
canada.summary: Muskox numbers across the Northwest Territories and Canada's Arctic islands have declined over the past two decades, though the animal is not currently considered a species at risk in Canada or the N.W.T.

canada.title: Public being asked to help shape future of 356-year-old Hudson's Bay royal charter
canada.summary: The four institutions sharing Hudson's Bay's royal charter are launching a public consultation to help decide how access to and education around the 356-year-old document are handled in the future.

canada.title: What is the cost to leave an abusive relationship in Alberta? A new report works to find out
canada.summary: A new report from Alberta Council of Women’s Shelters found family violence shelters in Alberta are seeing fewer people reaching out for help and fewer people coming into shelter because the financial burden of fleeing abuse is too much for some survivors to bear.

canada.title: Fort St. John's youngest-ever city councillor embraces new leadership role
canada.summary: The 20-year-old says he hopes to bring a fresh perspective to city hall, and help build a community more people will choose to call home.

canada.title: Court certifies class action alleging negligence at LTC home led to COVID-19 deaths
canada.summary: A lawsuit alleging that gross negligence at a Toronto long-term care home led to hundreds of deaths from COVID-19 has been certified as a class action.

canada.title: 'Power in this movement': Yukon NDP tables 100s of letters against Tenancies Act changes
canada.summary: The Official Opposition MLA behind a motion asking the Yukon legislature to reconsider changes to the Residential Tenancies Act says there’s a movement of people standing up to the amendments passed last week.

canada.title: Parents say new Harbour Landing school in Regina long overdue
canada.summary: The province announced the new joint-use school is 70 per cent complete and set to open next September.

canada.title: Committee backs bigger, YMCA-run pool on Saskatoon's east side
canada.summary: City administration had recommended moving ahead with a less ambitious hybrid model featuring a six-lane pool with a 4,000-square-foot fitness area, run by the YMCA as a city facility. But Coun. Zach Jeffries, whose ward is located on the east side of the city and who has long advocated for the new facility, proposed a bigger option.

canada.title: Woman dead after being struck by vehicle in Newmarket, police say
canada.summary: A woman in her 20s has died after being struck by a vehicle in Newmarket, Ont., on Wednesday evening, police say.

canada.title: 75% of Parks Canada employees in N.B. told their jobs could be at risk
canada.summary: The possibility of job losses for some Parks Canada staff could hit New Brunswick especially hard, with three-quarters of the department's employees in the province at risk.

canada.title: ‘Everybody’s pissed’: Sand blowing into homes next to rural N.S. subdivision development
canada.summary: Residents say they're fed up with blowing sand from the site of a subdivision development in the middle of a quiet neighbourhood in Coldbrook, N.S.

canada.title: Bay Roberts auto shops fed up with string of wheel thefts
canada.summary: Theft has been on wheels as of late, according to two automotive shops in Bay Roberts. Last Friday night, one business owner caught someone in the act.

canada.title: St. John’s library location search could be hampered by government criteria: MHA
canada.summary: For months, the people in the west end of St. John’s have been without a new library after the Michael Donovan Library closed its doors. As the provincial government is still looking for a new landlord to house the library, MHA Keith West is hoping the process will speed up.

Liz Landers reports.
